text: Jennifer Miller is a contractor with basic security training. According to policy, contractors are limited to read or write (if advanced training is present). Since she only has basic training, the maximum access allowed is read. Requesting write access exceeds her maximum allowed level.

author: Security agent
text: Employee is a contractor with basic security training. According to policy, contractors are limited to read access unless they have advanced training. Therefore, I recommend downgrading the requested write access to read access.
